# hostinger_website (Resource)

Hostinger Website resource. Manages a website on a Hostinger hosting plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostinger_website" "example" {
  domain   = "example.com"
  order_id = 1234567
}

resource "hostinger_website" "first_site" {
  domain          = "first-site.com"
  order_id        = 1234567
  datacenter_code = "us-east-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name for the website (without www).
- `order_id` (Number) ID of the hosting order/plan where the website will be created.

### Optional

- `datacenter_code` (String) Datacenter code. Required only when creating the first website on a new hosting plan.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Website ID (same as domain name)
